selection: Highest validation top1, earliest tie, one internal-test evaluation per selected checkpoint.
precision: FP32; Torch1.13.1+cu117, timm0.6.12, NumPy1.23.5 on both servers. Historical CIFAR10 used Torch2.2.2; do not pool old results.
historical_limitations: Exploratory development previously used official-test feedback and these original training images; new internal holdout does not erase historical bias.
